$description: The closed assetRole enum. Every media field in every section contract and in the PageSpec schema must name one of these. A bare 'image'/'src' string is not permitted anywhere.
globalRule: The source of these measurements is clay.com — a real, live company. This design-repo describes STRUCTURE AND MEASUREMENT ONLY. Nothing in it licenses reproduction of the original's artwork, copy, photography, trademarks or customer claims. A page generated from this repo must ship generated or client-owned assets.

brand.wordmark.licensing: Use the CLIENT's own wordmark. Never reproduce Clay's, and never generate a mark that imitates it.

customer.logo.licensing: These are OTHER COMPANIES' REGISTERED TRADEMARKS. A generated page must not reproduce a real third-party logo, and must not imply a customer, partner or integration relationship that does not exist. Use a neutral placeholder or an explicitly licensed mark.

person.photo.licensing: PHOTOGRAPHS OF IDENTIFIABLE PEOPLE. The original's /about and /careers carry a wall of real, named employees with real bios; /customers/* carry a quoted individual's headshot and a photo carousel. This build deliberately did NOT download the 486-tile headshot grid, customer-story card photography, event photography or the quoted individual's headshot. The capture pass now substitutes flat neutral tiles of the same box and radius inside team/grid/headshot/people containers, which is what cleared /about — but /careers has NOT been re-captured and still shows empty cells. WHETHER TO REPRODUCE ROUGHLY THIRTY NAMED INDIVIDUALS' FACES AND BIOS IS AN OPEN PRODUCT AND PRIVACY DECISION, DELIBERATELY LEFT FOR A HUMAN. This design-repo does not decide it either way. A generator MUST default to placeholder.neutral-tile and MUST NOT fabricate, reproduce or imitate a real person's likeness, name or bio.

placeholder.neutral-tile.licensing: A flat tile of the same box and radius as the photograph it replaces. Geometry and page height are unaffected — that is the point of it. This is the safe default for any people-bearing slot.

product.ui-screenshot.licensing: Screenshots of the ORIGINAL's product UI must not be reproduced. Generate or capture the client's own interface.

product.motion-film.renderRule: autoplay loop muted playsInline preload=none, started by IntersectionObserver #1 at rootMargin 200px, once.
product.motion-film.licensing: The original's films are Clay's own commissioned artwork. Replace them.

video.poster.renderRule: Every <video> carries its matching still as poster; the poster cross-fades out over 300ms ease once the video paints.
video.poster.licensing: A poster is a frame of the film it covers, so it inherits that film's position exactly: the original's stills are Clay's own commissioned artwork and must be replaced along with the video.

captured.section-plate.licensing: A 2x raster of the ORIGINAL's rendered page taken with its copy hidden. It is a derivative of the source site's artwork and must NEVER be shipped, published or reused outside this local development reference. There is no legitimate way for a generator to author a new one — this role exists so a validator can describe captured pages, not so anything can create them.

texture.paper.licensing: A full-bleed paper texture behind a hero band. Generate or license your own.

editorial.illustration.licensing: Editorial artwork is the original's commissioned work. Replace it.

diagram.static.licensing: An informational diagram rendered as a flat image. Regenerate it from the client's own facts; do not reproduce the original's pricing or company-history diagram.

fontsNotDownloaded.RoobertVF: The original's typeface is commercially licensed and the foundry licence does not permit self-hosting. Figtree substitutes via font.sans. Buying the licence and swapping that one token restores exact type fidelity.
fontsNotDownloaded.Canela: Same reason; not on the critical path.
